raw: I remember being at supper with an exchange student who was homesick. He had a photograph of his family beside his plate. Seeing that made me think about how hard it must be to be so far from home, especially when you’re sitting down to eat. I felt for him and wanted to do something to help, so I lent him my phone to call home. That’s what I remember most—the photograph and wanting him to be able to talk to his family.
